src='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    top, bottom = grid[0], grid[-1]
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    mark = next(v for v in top if v != 0)
    fill = (mark + 1) % 10
    for c in range(len(top)):
        if top[c] != 0 and bottom[c] != 0:
            for r in range(1, divider):
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
